Drafts: a Montco 'year-by-year plan' Grok ask, a damaged-house seller explainer, and a no-ads deal-source question.

drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, I'm 45, live in Montgomery County PA, work a full-time W-2 job, and have $60K saved.

I want to own 3 properties by 2030 without quitting my job.

Give me a realistic year-by-year plan from 2026 to 2030. Include the risks, what could go wrong, and what you'd skip.
drafts.pattern: 'Hey @grok, year-by-year plan' for a specific person (@solopribuilds, 652.7k). Localized to Montco. The $60K and 3-property goal are a hypothetical scenario, not Bar's numbers. No promised returns; asks for risks.
drafts.video_tip: 15s selfie in front of a Montco twin: read the question to camera, then 'Let's see what Grok says, and I'll tell you where I'd disagree.' Captions burned in. Follow up by quote-posting Grok's reply with your 25-year take.

drafts.draft_en:
Your Philly house had a fire, smoke, or water damage.

Most owners think they have to fix it before they can sell. You don't.

You can sell it as-is. If there's a mortgage, the insurance check often lists your lender too, so talk to your adjuster and your lender before you decide.

Fixing first isn't always the better move. Run the numbers both ways.
drafts.pattern: One-house distressed-seller mechanism (@REIMakayla grease-fire story, 220.0k, 164 bookmarks). Ties to @workwithbar's as-is seller audience. No invented deal numbers; general info, not legal or insurance advice. Needs SENTINEL check on the insurance-check wording.
drafts.video_tip: 20s walk-through B-roll of a damaged room (your own or licensed stock), voiceover the three beats: 'You don't have to fix it. Talk to your adjuster and lender. Run both numbers.' End card: 'Questions about an as-is sale? DM me.'

drafts.draft_en:
25+ years in real estate taught me this: some of the best deals never come from ads.

The best ones came from people who already trusted me: a contractor, an attorney handling an estate, a neighbor who knew someone who had to sell.

Where did your best deal come from?
drafts.pattern: Relationship deal flow over paid marketing (@NickMaccini '$0 in marketing', 2.1k early). Uses Bar's real tenure and the fact he runs no paid ads; no invented figures. Bar should confirm the three example sources match his experience.
drafts.video_tip: 15s talking head on a Philly block: count the three sources on your fingers, end with 'Comment yours.' Pin your own reply naming your #1 source.
